name: hot_side_momentum
author: BlitzkriegBot
description: Confirmed-leader holder for binary rounds: when a round is 40%-70% through, Binance spot momentum (|move| >= 0.10% inside a 15s window, real coverage) CONFIRMS the market's leading side — the one ask-priced in [0.60, 0.80] — buy that side at its ask and HOLD TO SETTLEMENT; the winner redeems $1.00/share. A momentum move contradicting the leader is not a trade; equal asks name no leader; a stale trigger describes a market that already repriced. One attempt per condition per round; exits are never emitted (collection happens at settlement). Signal-only: the kernel adjudicates, sizes, gates and settles every intent. Thesis death (issue 961 convergence, form B): declares BK_THESIS_DEATH_ENABLE = true — the stdlib default predicate (the held token's own bid reversed >= thesis_death_reversal_pct, default 25, sliding linearly to thesis_death_reversal_pct_tight, default 0 = off, as the round drains; or its quoting fields vanished/stale past thesis_death_stale_ms, default 30000) — enforced by the runtime as an unconditional same-tick full-taker close (exit_reason thesis_death_exit).
